2014_spells.watery-sphere.effectSummary: Make a target prone until it saves or the spell ends
2014_spells.watery-sphere.fullDescriptio: Using 1 action, you conjure up a 10-foot-diameter sphere of water at a point you can see within range. If it moves over a pit, a cliff, or other drop-off, it safely descends until it is hovering 10 feet above the ground; Any Medium or smaller creature in the sphere's space must make a Dexterity saving throw; roll a d20, add the DEX modifier, and compare it with your spell save spell save DC. If it moves over a pit, a cliff, or other drop-off, it safely descends until it is hovering 10 feet above the ground; you must concentrate, and the effect ends if your concentration ends.
